history.notes: Input spend guard: added a per-prompt character cap (Max Prompt Characters, default 8000, 100–100000). An Ask whose prompt exceeds the cap is failed with Request Failed BEFORE the spend-window count and any network call. The max_completion_tokens cap only ever bounded the answer, so a runaway scene that concatenated a huge variable could have shipped a large input-token charge to the customer's account on every Ask — this bounds the request too. · Honest server-side truncation: when OpenAI stops at max_completion_tokens (finish_reason "length") the answer is cut off mid-thought. The driver still fires Response Ready and publishes what came back, but Status now reads "truncated at token cap — raise Max Response Tokens" instead of presenting a partial answer as if it were complete. With the 256-token default this is a common case, not an edge one.
